Transfer classification data from disperseR object to a base dataset

Source: R/transfer.disperseR.R
transfer.disperseR.Rd

Merges behavioral or movement phase classifications generated in a disperseR object back into an external base data.frame using temporal or spatial matching methods.

Usage

transfer.disperseR(
  base.df,
  disperseR.obj,
  id.col = "name",
  time.col = "timestamp",
  method = "temporal",
  coord.names = c("x", "y"),
  max.diff = NULL
)

Arguments

base.df

A data.frame containing the target dataset where variables will be transferred.

disperseR.obj

An object of class disperseR containing the analyzed data.

id.col

Character. Column name in base.df representing individual identifiers.

time.col

Character. Column name in base.df representing timestamps.

method

Character. The matching method to use for transferring data. Choose one of:

  • "temporal": Matches each row to the closest point in time.

  • "spatial": Matches each row to the closest point in space using minimum Euclidean distance.

  • "forward": Matches each row to the nearest future location in the disperseR object.

  • "backward": Matches each row to the nearest past location in the disperseR object].

  • "movement": Uses temporal matching but applies a specific criteria for phase transitions. If the target point falls between two identical phases, it assigns that phase. If it falls exactly between a ARP (Area-Restricted Phase) and a movement phase, it prioritizes assigning the movement phase.

  • "arp": Uses temporal matching but applies a specific criteria for phase transitions. If the target point falls between two identical phases, it assigns that phase. If it falls exactly between a ARP (Area-Restricted Phase) and a movement phase, it prioritizes assigning the ARP phase.

coord.names

Character vector of length 2. Names of the X and Y coordinate columns in base.df, required if method = "spatial".

max.diff

Numeric. Optional. Maximum allowed time difference (in seconds) for a match to be considered valid.

Value

A data.frame based on base.df with appended classification columns from the disperseR object.

Examples

eps <- get.epsilon(sim_states)
#> Computing a global threshold using all data combined.
arp <- get.arp(sim_states, epsilon = eps, delta.days = 2, pct.state1 = 0.2)
mov <- class.mov(link.arp(arp, thres = 24 * 3600))

# Transfer phases back to the original (irregular) fixes
out <- transfer.disperseR(sim_tracks, mov, id.col = "ID",
                          time.col = "timestamp", max.diff = 3600)
#> Data transferred for 5 individuals
table(out$ID, out$phase)
#>      
#>       ARP Type 0 Type 1 Type 2 Type 2 or Type 1 Type 3
#>   F02 566     48      0    124                0      0
#>   F04 580     47    119      0                0      0
#>   F05 143    146      0      0              121      0
#>   M01 766     55     61     93                0     80
#>   M03 323     51      0     67                0      0
